clips.action: standing LEFT profile, sniffing the ground: lower head slightly, nose down, sniff with ears attentive, lift nose slightly. Keep full adult body scale, stable planted feet and back.
sitting LEFT profile, following something with eyes and head: look slightly down-left, level-left, up-left, settle level-left. Keep identical seated body and head proportions.
sitting LEFT profile: attentive seat, raise chin a little, lift chest proudly, settle proud upright seat. Stable head and visible pink eye.
sitting LEFT profile: relaxed, ears perk and eyes open wider, attentive tall sitting, hold alert seated pose. Do not draw warning symbols; runtime adds the effect separately.
sitting LEFT profile, gentle anxious pant cycle: mouth closed, mouth open a little with coral tongue, tongue out slightly, mouth nearly closed. Stable head and body.
sitting LEFT profile: mouth closed, tiny tongue emerges, tongue curls onto nose, tongue retracts, mouth closes. Head identical proportions and pink eye stays visible in ALL frames.

left-facing profile gentle landing bounce: descending with tucked legs, paws contact floor, knees flex into crouch, small upward rebound, legs straighten to ground, settled standing. Same dog and skull size, baseline appropriate to jump; do not draw dust or effects.
left-facing standing profile, playful ready posture: alert standing, front knees bend, slight play bow looking ahead, alert playful stance. No ball in the art: toy is separate.
left-facing sitting profile: notice offered toy, glance down, turn head slightly away in dismissive pout but stay profile-left, settle disinterested. No toy in art.

left-facing sitting profile, accepting a treat: attentive, nose reaches forward, mouth opens slightly, chew with tiny coral tongue, content closed-mouth seat. No hand/treat visible, separate object layer. Ears tail and paws NEVER cropped.

left-facing profile walking slowly back home then sitting: step left with forepaw forward, opposite forepaw step, slow standing, hips lower to seated, settled upright seat. Stable head and visible pink eye in final frame.
left-facing sitting profile: quiet upright seat, tiny tail sway, ears relax, return quiet seat. Stable face and small clear pink eye. NO cage in artwork, furniture is separate.
left-facing profile exiting cage: seated and alert, lean forward, rise to standing, step left, happy stable standing. NO cage in artwork, no cropping, small clear pink eye.
